scope: Real full-row repository action, native folder cancellation/selection and long-path tooltip; worktree creation and the narrow/language/theme variants are separate sessions.
checks: The existing current Git checkout is visibly selected before search.
An actual unmatched query is visible in the repository search editor.
The right side of the entire Add new repo row shows hover and opens the genuine native folder dialog.
Cancelling the native dialog preserves the original selected repository.
A center-row click opens the folder dialog again; choosing the existing long nested checkout directory visibly replaces the path despite the former query.
Hovering the selected path reveals the full chosen directory in its tooltip.
Modal cancellation preserves original shell PID, nonexported marker and cwd; independent before/after Git status, HEAD and one-worktree inventory remain byte-identical.
Finish explicitly within 480 seconds; no session expiry and no overall product acceptance implied.
